Class RedisDistributedLockClient

java.lang.Object
io.github.coderjeffery.distributedlock.redis.RedisDistributedLockClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
DistributedLockClient, AutoCloseable
public final class RedisDistributedLockClient extends Object implements DistributedLockClient
Factory for RedisDistributedLock. One client id is shared so reentrancy works across lock handles obtained for the same name.
